messages:
incident-bot: [ALERT] 5520001111 HIGH latency spike detected for streaming-infer-frontend (us-west). p99 > 2.5s for last 5m, streaming stalls observed. PagerDuty: PD-9876. Runbook: https://redwood.runbooks/streaming-latency

alicem: I'm oncall and looking. seeing p95 ~ 850ms, p99 ~ 3.1s. streaming tail shows lots of 'wait-for-kv' stalls.

sre-jane: checking cache metrics — prefix_cache.hit_rate dropped from ~0.92 to 0.10 around 01:12 UTC. prefetch queue length spiked.

eng-maya: we pushed prefix-salt v3 last night (canary -> prod) at 01:05 UTC. that touched prefix-hash scheme for streaming routes. could be incompat with existing cache keys.

brian: customer-reports: two customers opened tickets about stalled streams (CS-421, CS-422). both on dedicated pools in us-west.

product-joe: severity? do we have SLO breach visible to customers?

alicem: SLO alert trigger is active. p99 breach on hosted and dedicated routes for streaming-infer-frontend. I'm going to attempt a quick mitigation: disable prefetch/coalescing for streaming-critical routes to force uncached path but reduce stall dependency.

eng-maya: if prefix-salt change caused key mismatch, disabling prefetch probably helps because prefetch is producing many misses and blocking the warm path. agree with disabling prefetch.

alicem: running: ```
# disable prefetch for route streaming-infer-frontend
curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  https://console.redwood/api/v1/config/routes/streaming-infer-frontend/actions \
  -d '{"action":"set_prefetch","value":false}'
```

incident-bot: Action logged: config change by alicem at 5520001305.

alicem: prefetch disabled. monitoring...

sre-jane: also rolling back prefix-salt v3 -> v2 in the canary group to avoid further cache key drift. rolling back canary now, will hold for 5m then promote if stable.

eng-maya: rollback command: ```
kubectl -n infra rollout undo deploy/prefix-scheme --to-revision=20240201-v2
```

sre-jane: rollback started at 5520001410. observing cache warmup behavior.

alicem: telemetry: cache_miss_rate for streaming routes at 01:14 UTC = 0.88, prefetch backlog 4.2k, inflight requests waiting on kv ~ 600.

brian: forwarding impact to CS. CS notes that priority customers are affected with ~15-30% streams failing to progress.

customer-success-anna: drafting customer note. will call top-5 customers on the affected dedicated pools. prepping mitigation summary + ETA. :phone:

product-joe: want a quick blameless RCA note: if prefix-salt change invalidated keys, we need a compatibility test in the model onboarding flow.

alicem: initial mitigation results: p95 down to ~420ms within 4m of disabling prefetch; p99 reduced from 3.1s to 1.9s in ~6m after rollback start. continuing to watch tail.

incident-bot: PD-9876 update: mitigation in progress, customers notified.

sre-jane: promoting rollback from canary to 30% now to speed key homogenization. will watch cache hit rate.

eng-maya: temporary warmup step: run aggressive prefetch for warmup using old-scheme keys for 10m on dedicated pools only, to refill caches: ```
./prefetch_tool --route streaming-infer-frontend --scheme v2 --concurrency 8 --duration 600
```

alicem: OK starting warmup now.

brian: monitoring dashboard: https://dashboards.redwood/streams/streaming-infer-frontend (watch p95/p99 and prefix_cache.hit_rate).

alicem: p99 at 5520001700 = 1.75s, prefix_cache.hit_rate creeping back to 0.67. prefetch queue clear.

sre-jane: logs from proxy show fewer "kv-miss" errors after rollback. example: `WARN proxy: prefix-kv miss for key=... scheme=v3` earlier; now hits for scheme=v2 returning.

product-joe: what's outstanding? any lingering customer impact?

customer-success-anna: two customers still see intermittent stalls while their dedicated pools warm up; I've got CS channels open and ETA ~30m. drafting external comms now.

alicem: next steps: 1) complete rollback to v2 across region, 2) run warmup for dedicated pools + monitor 30m, 3) postmortem to cover missing pre-deploy validation and add a canary-metric gate for prefix_cache.hit_rate and prefetch-miss-rate.

sre-jane: assigned postmortem owner: eng-maya. pre-deploy test owner: alicem. CS comm owner: customer-success-anna.

eng-maya: root cause hypothesis: prefix-salt v3 deployed without compatibility shim; cache keys salted differently => massive misses and prefetch thrash that induced streaming stalls. will include proof in postmortem.

alicem: handing off oncall to sre-jane for coverage. I'm going offline in 15m. keep watching p99 < 2s. :thumbsup:

sre-jane: taking handoff. will keep this incident in monitoring. please add any customer updates here.

incident-bot: Incident 5520001111 mitigated enough to avoid expanded outage at 5520001895. Postmortem required.

alicem: thanks team — great quick coordination. we avoided a wider SLO breach.

product-joe: when postmortem draft ready, share in #postmortems and schedule retro with eng/CS/infra.

customer-success-anna: customer comms sent for affected customers. tracking follow-ups.

sre-jane: closing bridge shortly, leaving monitoring alerts to watchlist.
